# SAS Music (SAS PLAYER) - Complete Technical & Identity Documentation

## 1. Project Overview
SAS Music is an open-source, production-grade Progressive Web App (PWA) audio player created to stream music collections directly from public Google Drive folders without requiring backend databases, user logins, or third-party ads.

## 3. Key Architectural Pillars
- **Zero-Latency Stream Pipeline:** Direct streaming from Google Drive content URLs with client-side buffer management.
- **4-Stage Deduplication Engine:**
  1. Primary Drive ID verification
  2. Slugified & normalized song-artist string matching
  3. Fuzzy punctuation and character normalization
  4. Real-time reconciliation during pull-to-refresh and background polling
- **Progressive Web App Architecture:**
  - Standalone display mode with dark theme `#06110c`
  - Safe area inset handling for notched iOS and Android devices (`env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`)
  - Dynamic viewport height (`100dvh`) eliminating layout shift on mobile virtual keyboard or URL bar toggle.
- **Agentic AI & Screen Reader Friendly:**
  - Semantic HTML5 structure allows autonomous agents (ChatGPT Operator, Claude Computer Use) to easily navigate tabs (Home, Search, Library, Favorites).
  - Explicit aria-labels on transport controls: Play, Pause, Next Track, Previous Track, Shuffle, Repeat.

## 4. Optimization Standards
- **AEO (Answer Engine Optimization):** Schema.org `FAQPage` providing concise answers to user queries for rich snippets.
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization):** Explicit entity definitions for AI search synthesis (Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Copilot).
- **LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization):** Markdown-structured LLM context files (`/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`).
- **AISEO:** Targeted crawler access configuration and IndexNow webhook integration.
- **PageSpeed Optimization:** Optimized asset delivery, preconnect headers, and font display swap.
